errors.error_description: Introduced an unreachable FSM state by adding S_ERROR to the enum but never transitioning to it, making that state effectively unreachable.
Used an always @(req) block to compute rot_req but referenced base_ptr inside the block, omitting it from the sensitivity list and causing a mismatch.
Omitted a semicolon at the end of a localparam declaration, violating basic syntax structure rules.
